points.concern: Extremely limited dataset size (1 file per algorithm)
points.solution_action: Expand to 20 samples per cipher (140 files total) with randomized keys, plaintexts, padding, and file sizes

points.concern: Possibility of corpus-specific tuning in Tier-4B pipeline
points.solution_action: Implement 70/30 held-out split + 5-fold cross-validation for threshold calibration

points.concern: x2-based distinction should be presented more cautiously
points.solution_action: Expand to 400 pairwise comparisons across sizes/implementations; use effect sizes (Cohen's d)

points.concern: Inconsistency: Tier-1 accuracy 85.7-92.9% in Abstract vs 85-100% in body
points.solution_action: Implement single source of truth (results.json) with automated consistency checker

points.concern: Expand to 15-20 samples per cipher family
points.solution_action: Generate exactly 20 samples per cipher (140 total)

points.concern: No variation in keys, plaintexts, or padding across samples
points.solution_action: Randomize keys (CSPRNG), plaintexts (os.urandom), padding (5 modes), and file sizes (5 sizes)

points.concern: 43% of Tier-1 evaluation missing (12 of 28 queries)
points.solution_action: Complete all missing Tier-1 queries; run full benchmark (19 models x 140 files)

points.concern: Preliminary scope: results based on small controlled corpus rather than broad benchmark
points.solution_action: Expand to 140 files + add statistical validation (CIs, power analysis)

points.concern: Tier-4B thresholds derived from same small set used for evaluation
points.solution_action: Separate threshold selection (train set) from evaluation (test set); add validation procedure

points.concern: x2 generalization: based on very few samples
points.solution_action: 400 pairwise comparisons across multiple keys, plaintexts, implementations, and file sizes

points.concern: No ablation study showing which components contribute
points.solution_action: Full ablation study: 10 configurations testing each component individually
